title: Computing Systems Arena question
description: One practice question for the Computing Systems course. Week files and the mock test store objects of this shape.

id.description: W02-Q014 is quiz question 14 of week 2. W02-X03 is extra question 3. MOCK-17 is mock question 17.

code.description: Program or command block that belongs with the prompt, or the model solution for a code question.

correctAnswers.description: Option ids for mcq and multi. The model answer text for short, scenario, and code.

explanation.description: The ebook's why, or an empty string when the ebook gave no separate explanation.

difficulty.description: Derived from the question shape. The ebook does not rate difficulty. 1 is a single-answer MCQ with no code, 2 is multi-select, short answer, or an MCQ that traces code, 3 is a scenario or a code-writing question.

trapTags.description: Sentences in which this ebook marks an option or idea as a trap. Empty when it does not.

answerSource.description: Present on quiz questions. quiz means the review showed the answer. worked_out means the answer was worked out rather than taken from the quiz review.

needsReview.description: Set when the ebook's capture is ambiguous, reconstructed, or disagrees with itself.
